caption: The heading folds before the rule. The next section stays visible.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['hr-fold-stop']; p.pro.signOut(); p.settings = { enabled: true, folders: [], overrideProperty: 'fold-stop' }; await p.saveSettings();const leaf = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); const path = app.workspace.getActiveFile().path; await leaf.setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{file:path,mode:'source',source:false}}); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const ed = app.workspace.activeEditor.editor; ed.exec('unfoldAll');ed.setCursor({line:0,ch:0}); ed.exec('toggleFold'); return 'ok'; })()
